items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (chapter material the base extraction missed). Adapted from EXERCISES (Talk about how close a certain place is to where you are now).
items.pronunciation: hai, chikai desu. aruite gofun gurai desu

items.english: It's next to the police box.
items.target: こうばんのとなりにあります
items.pronunciation: kōban no tonari ni arimasu
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: [place]の となりに あります. Paired with fib-ginkou-doko-q, which is being removed as over-represented; the source already answers this way once (ラーメンやの となりに あります).

items.english: Smith-san isn't in the president's office.
items.target: スミスさんはしゃちょうしつにいません
items.note: Plain negative existence for a person. Different from だれも いません (there is no one), which needs the だれも construction.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: paradigm).
items.pronunciation: Sumisu-san wa shachōshitsu ni imasen

items.english: The soba shop is next to the police box.
items.target: そばやはこうばんのとなりです
items.pronunciation: sobaya wa kōban no tonari desu

items.english: Where is the bank?
items.target: ぎんこうはどこにありますか
items.pronunciation: ginkō wa doko ni arimasu ka
items.reviewNote: Excluded by the semantic de-dup pass. Pattern: [place]は どこに ありますか. The source already asks this exact frame four times (cabinet key, bookstore, plain どこに ありますか, and the Nozomi file), so another example just swaps in 'bank' with nothing new.

items.english: Smith-san was in the president's office.
items.target: スミスさんはしゃちょうしつにいました
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: paradigm).
items.pronunciation: Sumisu-san wa shachōshitsu ni imashita

items.english: Where are you now, Suzuki-san?
items.target: すずきさん、いまどこですか
items.note: いま どこですか is the short form of いま どこに いますか — with a person, the place +です contraction works the same way it does for things (GRAMMAR 2).
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (chapter material the base extraction missed). Lifted VERBATIM from SPEAKING PRACTICE 2.
items.pronunciation: Suzuki-san, ima doko desu ka

items.english: What is under the desk?
items.target: つくえのしたになにがありますか
items.pronunciation: tsukue no shita ni nani ga arimasu ka

items.english: How many men are there in the restaurant?
items.target: レストランにおとこのひとがなんにんいますか
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (chapter material the base extraction missed). Lifted VERBATIM from EXERCISES B (Ask and answer how many people are in a certain place).
items.pronunciation: resutoran ni otoko no hito ga nannin imasu ka

items.english: About what time will you get back to the office?
items.target: なんじごろかいしゃにかえりますか
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (chapter material the base extraction missed). Lifted VERBATIM from SPEAKING PRACTICE 2.
items.pronunciation: nanji goro kaisha ni kaerimasu ka

items.english: Town

items.target: それから、このたきはここからちかいですか

items.english: There are a lot of guests at the reception desk.
items.target: うけつけにおきゃくさんがたくさんいます
items.note: たくさん sits where a number and counter would, and like a number it takes no particle after it.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: particle).
items.pronunciation: uketsuke ni okyakusan ga takusan imasu
